question: does the investment-coverage read model classify a dataset the same way the assessment path does?
answer: no, on all three committed real-issuer manifests for this issuer
assessmentRule: fundamentals/datasetClass.ts — the declared rights evidence, fail-closed to UNKNOWN
coverageRule: coverage/investmentCoverage.ts financialClass() — a substring test on manifest.provider and manifest.licence
repudiation: datasetClass.ts documents that exact substring test under "WHAT WAS WRONG" and removes it; investmentCoverage.ts was added later and reintroduces it
whyNotCorrectedHere: the coverage report's class vocabulary is SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE | OPERATOR_SUPPLIED | NONE, and NONE drives a "no dataset is installed" UI state (InvestmentCoveragePage.tsx datasetAbsent). A fail-closed answer for "manifest present, rights unknown" needs a fourth member, which is a contract decision for the register owner, not a narrow IRR correction inside a validation work item
